title: CareLevo pairing/connection fails on Android OS 13
symptom: Pairing/connection does not complete properly on Android OS 13. The connection flow appears to work normally on Android 14 and above.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state the root cause, but the fix commit and additional changes suggest it was related to isBonded handling and Android OS 13 specific issues.
fix: The issue was fixed by a commit and additional changes including Android OS 13 handling and scan selection updates.
